summary.zh: 番茄红、芝士白、罗勒绿，那不勒斯献给王后的意大利国旗。
summary.en: Red tomato, white mozzarella, green basil — Naples' edible Italian flag for a queen.

ingredients.zh: 盐 5 克、橄榄油 1 大勺
圣马扎诺番茄罐头 200 克

steps.zh: 酵母溶于温水，加面粉、盐、橄榄油揉成光滑面团，室温发酵 2 小时至两倍大（冷藏慢发酵 24 小时风味更佳）。
steps.en: Dissolve yeast in warm water; knead with flour, salt and oil. Rise 2 hours until doubled (24h cold ferment is even better).

steps.zh: 番茄罐头用手捏碎，加一小撮盐，不要炒制，保持生番茄的鲜甜。
steps.en: Crush tomatoes by hand with a pinch of salt — no cooking, keep the fresh sweetness.

steps.zh: 面团排气分两份，用手从中间向外推开成 25 厘米圆饼，边缘留厚做成饼边。
steps.en: Divide dough in two; press from center outward into 25cm rounds, leaving a thick cornicione rim.

steps.zh: 烤箱连石板或烤盘一起预热到最高温（250°C 以上），至少预热 30 分钟。
steps.en: Preheat oven with a stone or tray at maximum heat (250°C+) for at least 30 minutes.

steps.zh: 饼底抹一层番茄酱，撒撕碎的马苏里拉，送入烤箱最上层烤 7-10 分钟至饼边焦斑隆起。
steps.en: Spread a thin layer of sauce, scatter torn mozzarella, bake on the top rack 7–10 minutes until the crust is leopard-spotted.

steps.zh: 出炉铺新鲜罗勒叶，淋少许橄榄油，静置 1 分钟切块。
steps.en: Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil; rest 1 minute before slicing.

tips.zh: 不要用擀面杖，用手推压才能保住面团里的气泡。
tips.en: Skip the rolling pin — hand-pressing preserves the air bubbles.

tips.zh: 酱料宁少勿多，正宗的玛格丽特是「看得到饼底」的。
tips.en: Less is more — you should see the crust through the sauce.

tips.zh: 马苏里拉提前沥干切块，避免出水泡软饼底。
tips.en: Drain mozzarella well so it doesn't flood the crust.

failChecks.zh: 饼底湿软：酱料太多或烤温不够，烤箱务必充分预热。
failChecks.en: Soggy base? Too much sauce or underheated oven — preheat thoroughly.

failChecks.zh: 饼边发白不膨：发酵不足或烤箱温度低，延长发酵时间。
failChecks.en: Pale flat crust? Under-proofed dough or cool oven — ferment longer.

failChecks.zh: 芝士焦了饼还没熟：位置太高，下移一层或减少芝士量。
failChecks.en: Cheese burnt before crust cooked? Move down a rack or use less cheese.

culturalStory.zh: 1889 年，那不勒斯披萨师傅拉斐尔·埃斯波西托为到访的玛格丽特王后创制了一款以番茄、马苏里拉和罗勒为配料的披萨，红白绿三色恰似新生的意大利国旗，王后将之名赐予此饼。2017 年，那不勒斯披萨制作技艺入选联合国非物质文化遗产。真正的玛格丽特只有三味配料——大道至简，正是意大利美食的哲学。
culturalStory.en: In 1889, Neapolitan pizzaiolo Raffaele Esposito created a pizza of tomato, mozzarella and basil — the red, white and green of the young Italian flag — for Queen Margherita, who lent it her name. In 2017, the art of Neapolitan pizza-making joined UNESCO's Intangible Heritage list. True Margherita carries only three toppings: simplicity itself is the philosophy of Italian cuisine.
